@@U01419@@
Yes, but many bad hours, too. The cradle was beside my bed at night, and every time she moved I woke, one time to give her a drink, another to take her in beside me, and when she wouldnt’ stop crying I'd dandle her, walking back and forth, and the next morning, bright and early, I'd be at the washtub— after which came marketing and cooking. And so it went, day in, day out, every day no different from the one before. Life was no bed of roses, but your food tastes all the better, and rest is sweeter, too.

@@U01420@@
(They walk on.)

@@U01422@@
Women are in a bad way, poor things; it’s no easy task converting a confirmed bachelor.

@@U01424@@
It would take only one of you to convert me, madam.

@@U01426@@
Come now, admit it, sir: haven't you found anyone? Has your heart never found a haven?

@@U01428@@
As the proverb has it: “A man’s hearth and a good woman are worth their weight in pearls and gold.”

@@U01430@@
I mean: Have you never felt the urge?
translation:
@@U01419@@
是的，但也有很多糟糕的时间。晚上，摇篮就在我的床边，每次她一动，我就会醒过来，一次给她喝点水，另一次把她抱到我身边，当她不停地哭泣时，我就抱着她，来回走动，第二天一早，天又亮，我就去洗衣盆旁——然后就是营销和做饭。就这样，日复一日，每一天都和以前没有什么不同。生活并不称心如意，但你的食物味道更好，休息也更甜蜜。

@@U01420@@
（他们继续走。）

@@U01422@@
女人的处境很糟糕，很可怜；转变一个已确定的单身汉并不是一件容易的事。

@@U01424@@
女士，只需要你们中的一个人就能改变我的信仰。

@@U01426@@
来吧，承认吧，先生：你还没找到人吗？你的心还没有找到避风港吗？

@@U01428@@
俗话说：“男人的心和女人的良善，抵得上珍珠和黄金。”

@@U01430@@
我的意思是：你从来没有感受到这种冲动吗？
